articles.summary: DeepMind researchers used LLM-guided evolutionary search to discover new activation functions that improve neural network generalization beyond the training distribution
articles.title: Mining Better Activation Functions with LLMs

articles.summary: Two new papers from Google show that a small encoder-decoder model trained from raw text can predict complex system and code metrics far better than traditional tabular regression, opening the door to fast, learned surrogates for ML model search.
articles.title: Regression Language Models: Predicting Anything from Raw Text

articles.summary: DeepMind researchers used meta-gradient optimization over a population of agents to automatically discover DiscoRL, a reinforcement learning rule that surpasses MuZero, DreamerV3, and all other handcrafted algorithms on Atari, ProcGen, and NetHack
articles.title: Discovering State-of-the-Art Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
